findings.evidence: docs/cross-cutting/error-handling.md states under HTTP Status Codes: 'None of the five module overview documents state which HTTP status codes individual finance-planner routes actually return (for example ... what POST /api/plans/{planId}/items returns when the plan is not owned by the caller)' and under Error Classification / Not Found: 'No overview states how a not-found plan, planned item, or user is reported to the caller.' docs/cross-cutting/api-conventions.md makes the same claim under HTTP Status Codes: 'None of the synthesized module overviews states which HTTP status codes the route handlers actually return.'
findings.locationHint: | Plan not found / not owned by user | `404` `{"error": "Not found"}` |
findings.message: This use-case doc documents the exact status codes and error body for POST /api/plans/{planId}/items (401, 404 with {"error":"Not found"}, 400 with details, 201 on success), directly contradicting docs/cross-cutting/error-handling.md and docs/cross-cutting/api-conventions.md, both of which assert that no document states which HTTP status codes this route returns, including specifically the not-owned/not-found case.
